PARAM-LBR-MIN-LABOR-AGE.evidence: No questionnaire universe line specifying labor-module minimum age is present on the relevant labor columns (e.g., FI010, FI120 show universe 'asked of —'). The person-level labor file silc24_p appears to cover only a subset of persons compared with the roster silc24_pr (rows 61,846 vs 80,727), consistent with a typical 15+ personal questionnaire cutoff; authoring 15 as minimum labor-module age for this survey. Evidence: t1,t2,t4

PARAM-LBR-MIN-LABOR-AGE-YEAR.evidence: Same rationale as PARAM-LBR-MIN-LABOR-AGE; no distinct 12-month labor-module section universe is stated in column cards. Evidence: t1,t2,t4

preludes.reason: Survey provides annual net employee and self-employment income components (FG010, FG020, FG030, FG040) but no single labor-income total. Construct laborincome as row-wise sum of these components (treating missing components as 0, but keeping all-missing as NaN).
